description: Pre-registered reconciliation target for the pendulum/dullness metric family emitted by 'python3 scripts/labs-replay-eval.py --dynamics'. Every expectation is a value published in the forensics document (or in the agent pipeline that produced it) for the corpus named below, with an absolute tolerance that absorbs sampling scope. This file pins the implementation against the published analysis; it is not a balance target, and a candidate rules arm is expected to deviate from it. Point --verify-against at it only when the replay set is that corpus.
corpus: frontline-classes-wave-2-movement-factorial-v1 and its holdout: 810 verified replay-v3 matches

expectations.note: corpus size the published values were computed over
headline: P(the leading side pushes further), breach counted as the final uncensored advance
non-centre frontline transitions behind the pooled probability
S1/S4 gate input: share of matches reaching max ticks
trailing by two positions: the objective walks toward the loser
leading by two positions: the 5x penalty for winning
S3 gate input: sole-presence ticks whose run never closed a capture
share of earned capture progress destroyed by decay
sole runs that reach the contract's capture threshold
S3 gate input: capped matches with a >=50-tick frozen scoreboard
capped matches containing an exact whole-visible-state cycle >=50 ticks
the staring contest; published with Manhattan proximity, within tolerance under Chebyshev
S5 gate input: 2^entropy of the body-tick tile distribution
